Remark
[Correspondence with the initial-value problem via time reversal] ↗ def:viscosity-solution-terminal-value-problem ↗ def:viscosity-solution-cauchy-problem 1. ch10:10.3-rem-2\group Control Theory

If $u$ is a viscosity solution of (22), then $w(x,t):=u(x,T-t)$ is a viscosity solution of \[ \begin{cases} w_t - H(Dw, x) = 0 & \text{in } \R ^n \times (0,T) \\ w = g & \text{on } \R ^n \times \{ t = 0\} . \end{cases} \]
